def: To deprive or clear of flesh. Grew.
A place under ground; a subterrany. [Obs.] Sir T. Browne.
A dwelling in the country, used as a place of retirement fromthe city.
To enter or record in a journal or diary. Johnson.
A stringed instrument of music used by the Hebrews, the form ofwhich is not known.Praise the Lord with harp; sing unto him with the psaltery and aninstrument of ten strings. Ps. xxxiii. 2.
Affected with purse pride; puffed up with the possession ofriches.
